Cast Infernal Plunge for its escape cost by paying {R}, exling three other cards from your graveyard, and sacrificing Stiticher's Supplier.
When Stitcher's Supplier dies, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve Infernal Plunge, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {B}.
Cast Stitcher's Supplier for its escape cost by paying {B} and exling three other cards from your graveyard.
When Stitcher's Supplier enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards between your graveyard and/or hand.
description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U} or {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Breaking from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites: Dihada has at least four loyalty counters.
description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to mill four cards and create four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Release to the Wind from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, blinking Dihada.
Repeat.
